resale_co.name: Residential Resale Certificate
resale_co.issued_by: Borough of Roseland Code Enforcement Department (Code Enforcement Officer)
requirements: Inspection by Code Enforcement, with review for UCC, housing and zoning compliance
Working smoke detector on each level including the basement; 10-year sealed battery units allowed but may not replace required hardwired detectors
Carbon monoxide detector in the vicinity of all sleeping rooms
Explosive natural gas alarm installed per the manufacturer's specifications
Smoke, CO and explosive gas detectors no older than 10 years
No loose or missing stair treads, risers, handrails or guardrails
No loose or missing electrical panel covers, switch/receptacle plates or junction box covers
Sump pump (if any) piped outside, not into the sanitary sewer
Proper fit and venting of furnace/boiler and water heater to the chimney; water heater relief valve discharging 2 to 6 inches above the floor
No unsealed penetrations, holes or missing sheetrock or plaster in attached garage walls or ceilings
Seller must close all permits before the sale
Final water meter reading must be scheduled and completed before the certificate is released
Buyer's name and phone number must be given

fees.label: Residential resale certificate, per dwelling unit
fees.quote: Residential (R-2 through R-5) Resale, per dwelling unit: $200.

fees.label: Residential resale application fee (as printed on the application)

resale_co.how_to_apply: Complete the Residential Resale Application (Borough website, Forms & Applications) and submit it with the $200 fee to the Code Enforcement Department, 300 Eagle Rock Avenue, Roseland (cash or check). Check the box for a resale certificate, or for a temporary resale certificate, which needs a letter of request from the buyer's attorney. Schedule the final water meter reading separately.

evidence.quote: No owner, agent, or any person or entity, shall rent, lease, sell, transfer ownership, or in any way deliver up for use, change of use, or occupancy any business, building, dwelling unit, lodging unit, rooming unit, or boarding unit, until a residential resale certificate, residential rental certificate, commercial rental certificate, or commercial resale certificate has been issued by the Code Enforcement Officer

A Temporary certificate will only be considered upon receipt of a written request setting forth the reason for the request and a time schedule setting forth the unfinished items and when they will be completed.
Seller is responsible for closure of all permits prior to selling this property;
TEMPORARY RESALE CERTIFICATE - Buyers Attorney must provide a letter of request
Certificate will not be issued unless the buyers name and phone number have been received.

resale_co.notes: Borough Code Chapter 10 (Building and Housing) was read on ecode360; the resale fee is under the Non UCC Certificate of Continued Occupancy fees, payment due at application. The Code Enforcement Department Head position is listed as 'To Be Determined' in the Borough directory, so no contact name is given; Heidi Levine, Senior Technical Assistant, is at 973-403-6051 and the Zoning Officer, James Campbell, at 973-403-6071. The department email was taken from the directory's protected mailto link. Rental certificates ($100 per unit) and landlord registration are rental-only programs.

requirements: Smoke detector on each level, including the basement (10-year sealed battery units allowed; hardwired units may not be replaced with battery units)
Carbon monoxide detector in the vicinity of all sleeping rooms
A fire extinguisher is not required in one- and two-family homes (Borough code); the application's office checklist still has a fire extinguisher box

authorities.name: Borough of Roseland Code Enforcement Department (smoke/CO inspection is part of the Residential Resale Certificate)
authorities.how_to_apply: There is no separate smoke/CO application on the Borough site. The smoke, CO and explosive gas alarm inspection is done as part of the Residential Resale Certificate inspection, applied for on the Residential Resale Application.

evidence.quote: A residential resale certificate, residential rental certificate, commercial rental certificate, and or a commercial resale certificate shall not be issued until an inspection and/or test of all smoke detection devices, carbon monoxide devices, and explosive gas alarms within the building or structure shall have been performed by the Code Enforcement Officer
A fire extinguisher shall not be required to be equipped in one- and two-family dwellings, but shall be required in all other occupied structures.

LEAID: 0718-001 Roseland Boro ... Name: Roseland Constr Office Addr: 300 Eagle Rock Av ... Enf Auth. Municipal ... Fire Official Allen Bell, Jr Phone (973) 226-6565 ... Email fireprevention@roselandnj.org

fire_cert.notes: Roseland folds the state smoke/CO certificate into its Residential Resale Certificate; no separate smoke certificate fee is published, so the $200 resale fee appears to cover it (confirm). The state fire directory (survey 1/19/2023) lists Allen Bell, Jr as fire official with phone (973) 226-0512 and the smoke detector compliance office as the Roseland Construction Office at (973) 226-6565; the Borough directory lists Allen Bell, Fire Prevention Official, at 973-226-0512 and 862-469-9047, under Code Enforcement. The fireprevention@roselandnj.org email is from the state directory.

other_items.label: Final water meter reading
other_items.detail: The seller or seller's attorney must schedule the final water meter reading with the Borough Water Department before closing; the certificate is not released until it is done. A $150.00 final water meter read fee is added to the final water bill.

other_items.label: Open permits
other_items.detail: The seller must close all permits before selling.

other_items.label: Zoning compliance
other_items.detail: The resale certificate is issued only if the use complies with zoning or is a valid preexisting nonconforming use.

open_questions: Is a separate fee charged for the smoke/CO part of the inspection, or is it covered by the $200 resale fee?
How many days ahead should the resale application be filed, and is there an expedite fee? None is published.
Is there a reinspection fee? None was found in the resale fee section.
